text.title: Activation Tactics Failure Modes
text.summary: Six antipatterns observed when applying Activation Tactics. Each pairs symptom + root-cause + concrete fix. Detector clauses make them mechanically catchable.

antipattern.symptom: Playbook lists "add product tour" and "welcome email series" with no funnel step, baseline or activation event attached.
antipattern.root-cause: Tactics copied from a best-practice list instead of derived from the measured drop-off.
antipattern.fix: Reject per `r-tactic-targets-named-dropoff-step`; each tactic gets a step name and that step's current conversion before it enters `steps[]`.

antipattern.symptom: Checklist has eight items, three of them manually tickable; completion rate is high but activation is unchanged.
antipattern.root-cause: Checklist treated as a feature tour; items not bound to tracked events.
antipattern.fix: Cut to 3-5 event-bound items with one `activation_event: true` item per `r-checklist-single-activation-item`.

antipattern.symptom: Support receives replies saying "I already did this"; unsubscribe rate on Day 3 email is several times the account average.
antipattern.root-cause: Suppression condition evaluated at enrolment, not at send time.
antipattern.fix: Move the `not activated` check to send time per `r-email-sequence-suppressed-on-activation`; verify with a user who activates between Day 0 and Day 1.

antipattern.symptom: Email click-through is healthy; the targeted action's completion rate from email traffic is near zero.
antipattern.root-cause: CTA links to the home page or a login wall instead of the action screen.
antipattern.fix: Deep-link to the action per `r-email-one-cta-direct-link`; keep the session or pass an authenticated link where the product supports it.

antipattern.symptom: New users see three or more overlays on the first screen; session recordings show rapid dismissals before any action.

root-cause.source: Nielsen Norman Group guidance on instructional overlays

antipattern.root-cause: Guides added per feature launch, never removed, not tied to a drop-off step.
antipattern.fix: Remove guides from screens without a measured drop-off and enforce one active guide per screen per `r-in-app-guide-at-dropoff-only`.

antipattern.symptom: Checklist and tooltip launched on the same step in the same week; step conversion rises; nobody can say which to keep.

root-cause.source: Trustworthy Online Controlled Experiments (Kohavi, Tang and Xu)

antipattern.fix: Add a deferral branch per `r-one-tactic-per-step-at-a-time`; run the second tactic after the first has hit or missed its exit criterion.
